examples.title: Skeleton placeholders
examples.description: Animated loading placeholders for text and avatars.

examples.title: Lines and card
examples.description: lines stacks text bars; variant="card" draws a heading bar and lines inside a card.

examples.title: Loading rules
examples.description: Nothing for 300 ms, the skeleton until 10 seconds, then Still loading with Cancel.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, Skeleton } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  let loading = $state(false);
</script>

<Button label="Start loading" onclick={() => (loading = true)} disabled={loading} />

{#if loading}
  <Skeleton lines={5} delay={300} stillLoadingAfter={10000} onCancel={() => (loading = false)} />
{/if}

examples.title: List loading with a slow-loading line
examples.description: A status-first list placeholder in the real layout: nothing for 300 ms, rows until 10 seconds, then the page's own Still loading line with a ghost Cancel. It is not a banner and draws no spinner.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Skeleton } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  let loading = $state(true);
</script>

{#if loading}
  <Skeleton
    variant="list"
    rows={3}
    dayBand
    label="Loading runs"
    delay={300}
    stillLoadingAfter={10000}
    stillLoadingLabel="Still loading runs. This is taking longer than usual."
    onCancel={() => (loading = false)}
  />
{/if}
